children: RNS Number : 2906U  Conygar Investment Company PLC(The)  10 September 2026

The Conygar Investment Company PLC ("Conygar") is pleased to announce that Winfield Court, its Purpose-Built Student Accommodation development at The Island Quarter in Nottingham, is now fully let for the upcoming academic year.

"Achieving 100% occupancy at Winfield Court is a significant milestone and testament to the quality of the development. It reflects the strong demand for high quality, well managed student accommodation in Nottingham, one of the UK's leading university cities."

The information contained within this announcement is deemed by the Group to constitute inside information as stipulated under the Market Abuse Regulation (EU) No. 596/2014 as it forms part of UK domestic law by virtue of the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018.
